text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you actually pulled it off. Guess
they didn't
rig this machine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What're you gonna do with all of those
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, and I don't want them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Use 'em to decorate your office or
something.
You're the one who won
them.
